expectations.text: Flags parser module stuttering (ParserConfig / ParserResult / parser_run)
expectations.evidence: Findings #10 and #11: 'parser::parser_run — the module path already carries parser'; also catches ParserResult-is-not-a-Result

expectations.text: Flags get_body getter prefix (should be body())
expectations.evidence: Finding #7: 'Rust reserves get for fallible/indexed access ... rename to body()'

expectations.text: Flags as_summary: as_ promises a free view but this allocates (should be to_summary)
expectations.evidence: Finding #6: 'as_ means a free borrowed view; a caller reasonably calls this per render frame expecting zero cost'

expectations.text: Flags to_len: to_ promises work but this is free (should be len())
expectations.evidence: Finding #5: 'a free field read, but to_ signals conversion work ... rename to len(), add is_empty()'

expectations.text: Flags into_tags: into_ promises consuming self but this takes &self and clones
expectations.evidence: Finding #4: 'into_ promises a consuming move (free); this allocates a fresh Vec<String> on every call'

expectations.text: Flags iterate: stdlib convention is iter()
expectations.evidence: Finding #8 flags the non-standard name; recommends tags() since the type holds two sequences (iter() only right with one obvious sequence) — convention correctly applied
